The cork was swollen with salt. Inside lay a single page, folded small, written in pencil. It said: 'To whoever keeps the light: my brother sailed past you in 1987 and never came home. I only want to know if you saw him.' Elias read it three times. He had kept the logbooks since the day he arrived, and he knew exactly where the 1987 volume sat. That evening, with the beam turning slowly above him, he opened it and began to search the pages.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在空荡的街口投下昏黄的光，红绿灯仍旧按部就班地变换颜色，却没有一辆车为它停留。环卫工人推着扫帚走过人行道，沙沙声在楼宇间回响。早点铺的灯亮了，蒸笼里冒出第一缕白气，混着面粉与豆浆的香味飘向远处。便利店的玻璃门后，店员打着哈欠整理货架。天边还是深蓝色，只在高楼的缝隙里透出一线微弱的灰白。几只麻雀已经醒来，在电线上试着叫了两声。这座城市正悄悄换班，夜里的人睡去，白天的人尚未出门。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a nesting doll to find a smaller doll inside.\n- Each copy gets a little simpler, until you reach the tiniest one that you can finish right away. That is the stopping point.\n- Then you go back up, finishing each bigger job using the answer from the smaller one, until the whole thing is done."}
